Name: Color retexture of Main House - for direct use and maybe as inspirational groundwork
Author: OrinLinwe
Description:
I recently released [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4429?]a modder's asset that separated all layers[/url] from the buildable farm-buildings in the game. 

For the last couple of days, I've been playing around with color variants for the main house (since that's what usually carries the color theme) and I generated a pretty big selection of color variants. As of version 1.1, there are 42 variants. 

These all use the custom wood lifted from house 1, which not everyone might like, but I do. The majority of these variants also have a custom window for house 2, made from the window found in house 3, which I also prefer over the vanilla house 2 window. Again, aesthetics.

If you don't like the custom wall for house 2 and 3, you can pretty easily recreate these color variants with my modding asset file (which now has been updated to v1.1). I like the rustic look of the custom wood, but some might prefer the vanilla, "cleaner" plank-look. 

Not all of these color-variants are winners, by any means, but most of them are reasonably attractive, and cover a fairly broad spectrum of colors. I figured they could be useful either for direct use, or as a starting-point for anyone wanting to do their own recoloring, and looking for some inspiration. 

Though I wish I could make variants across all farm-buildings, that kind of work-load would be insane. I leave that up to you (the other buildings are far less complex in detail compared to the farmhouse, and using my modding file for Gimp and Photoshop makes it quite easy).  

Still, just releasing these farmhouse-variants might be useful for someone, and they were already on my hard-drive, so I figured why not. 

---------------------------

All these variants were made using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4429?]my Photoshop/Gimp resource file[/url]. If you like any of these - or decide to make your own version - you can use the same resource for quickly recoloring all buildable farm-buildings in the game (most other buildings are far less complex than the main house). 

To use any of them, rename the file you like to houses.png and pack it into a houses.xnb file. 

Cheers.

Downloads.Description: Added a few more "Pale Wood" variants with 3 blue and one purple
